name: VibeWave v2.3.0
body:
### 🚀 VibeWave Update

- ✨ **Voice Search & Assistant:** Alexa / Google Assistant style bol kar gana search karein!
- ⚡ **Super Smooth 60-120 FPS:** High performance lag-free playback.
- 🔄 **In-App Auto-Update:** Naye updates bina purana app delete kiye 1-tap me install karein!
- 🎨 **Alok Kushwaha Official Branding:** Verified creator profile & smooth UI.
